name: NIKI POONACHA
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A versatile player with a strong serve and aggressive baseline game, excelling in doubles with solid net skills.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #605 (January 14, 2019), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #102 (May 20, 2024).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw; reached qualifying rounds in singles.
Notable Achievements: ATP Challenger Titles: Won 3 Challenger doubles titles (2023 Astana with S D Prajwal Dev, 2024 Les Franqueses del Vallès with Ray Ho, 2024 Lisbon with Francis Casey Alcantara). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated top seed Sumit Nagal (World No. 121) at the 2024 Pune Challenger. ITF Success: Secured 3 ITF Futures singles titles and 8 doubles titles. Davis Cup & National Representation: Debuted for India in Davis Cup in 2023, contributing in doubles.
Other Highlights: Two-time Indian National Champion (2018, 2020). Known for a dramatic 9-match-point save in a 2023 Challenger doubles match with Adam Taylor. Continues to rise as a doubles specialist.
Niki is an emerging force in Indian tennis, balancing singles and doubles with a focus on Challenger success. 🎾🇮🇳
